metadata.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Configuration Fixtures
metadata.target_protocol: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Specification (Streamable HTTP Revision)
metadata.description: Production-tested, schema-validated MCP server configuration dictionaries for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code AI agent runtimes.

filesystem.description: Enables read/write access to explicitly sandboxed local directory trees.
filesystem.security_scope: Directory-level path sandboxing (must specify absolute directory paths)
filesystem.common_pitfalls: Omitting the directory argument causes immediate process termination. On Windows, use forward slashes (e.g., C:/Projects) or double-escaped backslashes to prevent JSON parse errors.

github.description: Official GitHub-maintained Go runner for issues, PRs, repository inspection, and commits.
github.security_scope: Fine-grained Personal Access Token (PAT) with repo and read:org permissions
github.common_pitfalls: Requires Docker daemon running locally. If running without Docker, download the official github-mcp-server standalone binary and replace command with the binary path. ${GITHUB_TOKEN} is a placeholder: Claude Desktop does not expand ${VAR} references in env values, so paste the real token (or use your client's own variable syntax, e.g. ${env:GITHUB_TOKEN} in Cursor and VS Code).

postgres.description: Hardened PostgreSQL server with schema inspection, query explanation, and read-only sandboxing.
postgres.security_scope: Database credentials (enforce --access-mode=restricted to block DDL/DML mutation)
postgres.common_pitfalls: The archived @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres has unpatched SQL injection risks; use crystaldba/postgres-mcp instead. Notice the env key is DATABASE_URI, not DATABASE_URL.

brave_search.description: Official Brave Search integration for real-time web querying and document discovery.
brave_search.common_pitfalls: Package migrated from @modelcontextprotocol scope to @brave scope. Missing BRAVE_API_KEY will result in 401 Unauthorized API rejections.

playwright.description: Official Microsoft-maintained headless and headed browser automation runner.
playwright.common_pitfalls: Spawns a visible browser window by default. For background automated runs, pass --headless in args. Requires Node.js 18+.

fetch.description: Web scraping and API querying tool with automatic HTML-to-Markdown parsing.
fetch.security_scope: Outbound HTTP requests (ensure SSRF policies protect internal cloud subnets)
fetch.common_pitfalls: Requires Python 3.10+ and uv installed. If Python is not available, run the official Docker image instead: command "docker", args ["run", "-i", "--rm", "mcp/fetch"]. There is no official npm package for this server.

git.description: Local repository inspection for diffs, log traces, branch operations, and staging.
git.common_pitfalls: Target directory must already be initialized with git (git init) and contain at least one committed tree.

sqlite.description: Node.js reimplementation of the archived official Python SQLite server, optimized for environments without a local uvx/Python toolchain.
sqlite.security_scope: Direct local SQLite database file access
sqlite.common_pitfalls: No single vendor-blessed successor exists for SQLite the way GitHub or Microsoft maintain their packages. This is a verified community option; confirm path write permissions prior to initialization.
